scope: Local car/bus/truck DET evaluation only; no model metrics have been produced.
coverage_rule: Exclude a source target or prediction when at least 50% of its box area is covered by the union of category-0, category-11 or score-0 source boxes.
box_geometry: Image-bound half-open pixel rectangles; invalid or out-of-image source boxes fail instead of being clipped.
non_target_categories: Scored categories other than car, bus and truck are not local positives and do not automatically mask predictions; van remains separate from car.
official_toolkit_difference: The official MATLAB source explicitly masks category-0 regions. Its README says others are ignored, but the inspected code does not explicitly mask category-11 boxes; the local pilot policy does. Pixel-edge conventions may also differ. Do not label local scores as official VisDrone scores until parity is checked.
training_policy: NOT_FROZEN; audit-only YOLO labels do not encode ignore masks.
